findings.body: The guard validates only the flag, host, and port; it accepts any database name. Consequently, `WAREHOUSE_PG_DATABASE=live_warehouse` and `PGDATABASE=live_app` pass when exposed on the expected loopback ports, after which the baseline code can truncate every public table. The manual-bypass test uses live-looking names only together with invalid ports, so it never detects this gap. Validate explicit disposable database identities (or a reliable server-side disposable marker) and test changing each database name alone before any write.
findings.title: Not done: destructive proof rejects real database identities

findings.body: Although `sourceCells` closes the prior Actual-column gap, the Budget oracle still classifies every populated row above outline level zero as a leaf. A normal nested outline with a level-1 subtotal parent and level-2 children therefore includes the parent as a financial leaf, causing fan-out, and the returned oracle contains no parent hierarchy with which later imports can be reconciled. The generated fixture only has a level-0 parent and level-1 leaves, so it cannot catch this. Add nested hierarchy/repeated-GL coverage and preserve/assert the independent Budget hierarchy rather than discarding every parent.
findings.title: Not done: unconditional generated-source oracle
